item.title: iPhone 18 Pro 昨日开卖：Pro Max 仍有加价，Pro 已出现破发
item.guid: iPhone-18-Pro-昨日开卖：Pro-Max-仍有加价，Pro-已出现破发
item.description:
The iPhone 18 Pro series went on sale in China on September 18. Reporters from Cailian Press visited Apple Stores in Shanghai, Guangzhou, and Shenzhen, where queues for pickup were seen outside all stores; some stores had no stock, and the official website's estimated arrival time for the Pro Max was already scheduled for mid-October, while the Pro was relatively easier to purchase. iPhone 18 Pro 系列 9 月 18 日在中国开售。财联社记者走访上海、广州和深圳三地 Apple Store，门店外均出现排队取货；部分门店没有现货，Pro Max 的官网预计到货时间已排到 10 月中旬，Pro 相对更容易买到。

The difference in demand in the second-hand market is even more pronounced. Several recyclers in Shanghai quoted a premium of about 350 to 400 yuan for the red Pro Max 256GB, while in Guangzhou, the red model generally commanded a premium of over 500 yuan. The blue model, which initially saw a premium of 1,000 yuan at launch, fell back to about 550 yuan in the morning; in Shenzhen, the red model had a premium of about 500 to 700 yuan. Many recyclers refused to accept the Pro, or were only willing to buy it back at its original price, stating that some models had already "fallen below issue price." 二手市场的冷热差异更明显。上海多名回收商给红色 Pro Max 256GB 报出加价约 350 至 400 元，广州红色款普遍加价 500 元以上，蓝色款开售时一度加价 1000 元、上午回落至约 550 元；深圳红色款加价约 500 至 700 元。多名回收商拒收 Pro，或只愿按原价回收，并称部分机型已经「破发」。

Apple's official website shows that the red 256GB Pro can be shipped in about 11 business days, and the Pro Max in about 15 business days; most colors of the Pro at JD.com's self-operated flagship store can be shipped within 1 to 2 days. The starting prices for the new domestic models are 9,999 yuan and 10,999 yuan, respectively, both 1,000 yuan higher than the previous generation. 苹果官网显示，红色 256GB Pro 约 11 个工作日可发货，Pro Max 约需 15 个工作日；京东自营旗舰店的 Pro 多数颜色可在 1 至 2 日内发货。新机国行起售价分别为 9999 元和 10999 元，均比上一代高 1000 元。

item.title: 暂停 8 天后，ChatGPT Pro 20X 限定回归
item.guid: 暂停-8-天后，ChatGPT-Pro-20X-限定回归
item.description:
After an 8-day suspension of new subscriptions, the ChatGPT Pro $200 tier (Pro 20X) has been reopened for repurchase by some eligible existing users, but new user subscriptions and regular upgrades remain suspended. 在暂停新订阅 8 天后，ChatGPT Pro 200 美元档（Pro 20X）已向部分符合条件的老用户开放重新购买，但新用户订阅与常规升级仍处于暂停状态。

OpenAI's help center states that this entry is only for users who previously subscribed to the plan: accounts must still hold a $200 subscription on September 10 local time, or their access must have ended within 30 days prior to that date. OpenAI 帮助中心说明披露，该入口仅面向此前订阅过该计划的用户：账号需在当地时间 9 月 10 日仍持有 200 美元订阅，或其访问权限在该日期前 30 天内结束。

Eligible users must resubscribe within 30 days after their access terminates and only have one chance to restore during the sales suspension period. Users who actively canceled, failed to renew, or downgraded from the $200 tier to the $100 tier (Pro 5x) are all eligible to participate. 符合条件的用户需在权限终止后的 30 天内重新订阅，且在暂停销售期间仅有一次恢复机会。主动取消、续费失败或从 200 美元档降级至 100 美元档（Pro 5x）的用户均可参与。

Previously, OpenAI suspended new subscriptions and upgrades for the $200 tier on September 10 due to excessive system compute load. Currently, the $100 tier is still being sold normally, with both tiers having the same benefits, differing only in their quotas, which are 5 times and 20 times that of Plus, respectively. The full reopening time for new users has not yet been announced. 此前，OpenAI 因系统算力负载压力过大，于 9 月 10 日暂停了 200 美元档的新增订阅与升级。目前 100 美元档仍正常销售，两档权益一致，仅额度分别为 Plus 的 5 倍与 20 倍。针对新用户的全面开放时间尚未公布。

🔗 Related reading: Just In: ChatGPT Pro 20X Limited Return 🔗 相关阅读： 刚刚，ChatGPT Pro 20X 限定回归

item.title: Gemini 4 Pro 疑似现身，实测表现接近 GPT-6
item.guid: Gemini-4-Pro-疑似现身，实测表现接近-GPT-6
item.description:
Recently, multiple users in anonymous battles on the large model arena Arena AI discovered that a model labeled "Gemini 3.8 Flash" showed significant performance improvement in SVG, web page, 3D scene, and interactive tool generation tasks, with some test results considered to be close to GPT-6 Astra. 近日，多名用户在大模型竞技场 Arena AI 的匿名对战中发现，一个标注为「Gemini 3.8 Flash」的模型在 SVG、网页、3D 场景和交互工具生成任务中的表现明显提升，部分测试结果被认为接近 GPT-6 Astra。

Some testers believe that the suspected Gemini 4 Pro model is close to GPT-6 Astra Pro in tasks such as "pelican riding a bicycle," while others prefer the quality and creativity of Fable 5.1's work. 有测试者认为，疑似 Gemini 4 Pro 的模型在「鹈鹕骑自行车」等任务中与 GPT-6 Astra Pro 接近，但也有人更偏好 Fable 5.1 的作品质量与创意。

Google has confirmed the initiation of Gemini 4 pre-training, stating it is the company's largest foundational model training to date. Google 已确认启动 Gemini 4 预训练，并称这是公司迄今规模最大的基础模型训练。

Meanwhile, the Gemini team has recently undergone management adjustments and core personnel changes, with product focus gradually shifting towards code, AI agents, video multimodal, and enterprise workflows. 与此同时，Gemini 团队近期经历管理层调整和核心人员变动，产品重点逐渐转向代码、AI 智能体、视频多模态和企业工作流。

🔗 Related reading: Gemini 4 Pro Allegedly Appears, Performance Nears GPT-6 in Tests, Is Gemini Back on Track? 🔗 相关阅读： Gemini 4 Pro 疑似现身，实测表现逼近 GPT-6，Gemini 又支棱起来了？

item.title: 赛力斯回应问界专属专营：用户权益不变，将择机进军轿车和 MPV
item.guid: 赛力斯回应问界专属专营：用户权益不变，将择机进军轿车和-MPV
item.description:
Kang Bo, Director and Vice President of Seres Group, for the first time systematically responded to the division of labor after AITO shifted to brand-exclusive operation: product definition, design, brand marketing, channel retail, and service system are led by Seres, with Huawei Terminal continuing to participate in empowerment. 赛力斯集团董事、副总裁康波首次系统回应问界转向品牌专属专营后的分工：产品定义、设计、品牌营销、渠道零售和服务体系由赛力斯主导，华为终端继续参与赋能。

According to insiders cited by "21 Auto · Yijian Auto," after AITO establishes an independent sales network, a certain proportion of stores will still be retained for sales in HarmonyOS Smart Travel shared showrooms; the authorization主体 for some Huawei supermarket stores will be transferred to Seres, and the channel separation plan is expected to be completed by December 31, 2026. Details regarding marketing division and resource investment are still under discussion. 《21 汽车 · 一见 Auto》援引知情人士称，问界建立独立销售网络后，仍会保留一定比例的门店在鸿蒙智行共享展厅销售；部分华为商超门店的授权主体将转为赛力斯，渠道分网计划在 2026 年 12 月 31 日前完成。相关营销分工和资源投入细节仍在商议。

He stated that the rights and interests of AITO's existing 1.2 million users, OTA upgrades, and subsequent services will not be affected. Seres also holds a 10% stake in Jinwang, and AITO will continue to receive technical, product, and supply guarantees from Huawei. 他表示，问界现有 120 万用户的权益、OTA 升级和后续服务不受影响。赛力斯同时持有引望 10% 股份，问界仍会获得华为的技术、产品与供应保障。

In terms of product layout, AITO plans to enter markets such as sedans and MPVs when the opportunity arises, and will make its debut at the Paris Motor Show in October. 在产品布局上，问界计划择机进入轿车、MPV 等市场，并将于 10 月亮相巴黎车展。

item.title: 钉钉创始人陈航出任百望股份非执行董事，年薪 10 万元
item.guid: 钉钉创始人陈航出任百望股份非执行董事，年薪-10-万元
item.description:
Baiwang Co., Ltd. held an extraordinary general meeting of shareholders on September 17, voting to approve Chen Hang's appointment as a director. The announcement shows that Chen Hang (alias "Wuzhao"), the founder of DingTalk, took office as a non-executive director of the company after the shareholders' meeting on that day. 百望股份 9 月 17 日召开临时股东大会，投票通过陈航的董事委任。公告显示，钉钉创始人陈航（花名「无招」）自当日股东大会结束后出任公司非执行董事。

Chen Hang's annual salary is 100,000 yuan, with no additional board meeting allowances. His term will last until the expiration of the current board's term, at which point he can be re-elected. 陈航的年薪为 10 万元，不另行发放董事会会议津贴。他的任期将持续至当前董事会任期届满，届时可连选连任。

item.title: 联想市值盘中超过美团，股价刷新高
item.guid: 联想市值盘中超过美团，股价刷新高
item.description:
On September 18, Lenovo Group's stock price rose by over 7% during intraday trading, reaching a high of HK$36.8. As of the time of reporting, Lenovo's market capitalization was approximately HK$455.4 billion, surpassing Meituan's HK$452.7 billion during intraday trading. This ranking fluctuates with real-time stock prices and does not represent a merger, acquisition, or business restructuring by the company. 9 月 18 日，联想集团股价盘中涨超 7%，最高触及 36.8 港元。截至报道发稿时，联想市值约 4554 亿港元，盘中超过美团的 4527 亿港元。这一排名随股价实时变动，不代表公司发生了并购或业务重组。

Morgan Stanley's report on September 17 stated that Lenovo's demand for general-purpose servers and AI servers is strong, and it expects the revenue growth rate of its ISG business to continue to accelerate, maintaining an "Overweight" rating and a target price of HK$46. 摩根士丹利 9 月 17 日的报告称，联想的通用服务器和 AI 服务器需求较强，预计 ISG 业务收入增速将继续加快，并维持「增持」评级和 46 港元目标价。

item.title: 小鹏与火山引擎合作落地 5000 个智能体，覆盖 800 多家供应商
item.guid: 小鹏与火山引擎合作落地-5000-个智能体，覆盖-800-多家供应商
item.description:
Volcano Engine disclosed on September 18 that XPeng Group is building an AI mid-end platform with HiAgent as its foundation. It currently has 2,000 active users, has created 5,000 intelligent agents, and 50 "digital employee" scenarios are gradually being implemented. The cooperation between the two parties also covers businesses such as R&D, office, marketing, cockpit, intelligent driving, and safety. 火山引擎 9 月 18 日披露，小鹏集团以 HiAgent 为底座建设 AI 中台，目前已有 2000 名活跃用户，累计创建 5000 个智能体，50 个「数字员工」场景正在逐步落地。双方的合作还覆盖研发、办公、营销、座舱、智驾和安全等业务。

XPeng's internal supply chain risk platform has set up 78 risk factors, covering over 800 suppliers. Volcano Engine stated that the risk assessment for new car model production capacity has been shortened from 2 days to 10 minutes, and monthly supplier risk reports have been shortened from 1 week to 1 hour; the jointly developed AI outbound calling tool has reduced related labor costs by over 50%. 小鹏内部的供应链风险平台设置了 78 个风险因子，覆盖 800 多家供应商。火山引擎称，新车型产能风险排查由 2 天缩短至 10 分钟，供应商月度风险报告由 1 周缩短至 1 小时；联合开发的 AI 外呼工具则使相关人力成本下降超过 50%。

In XPeng's first AI Open Competition, the number of participants exceeded 21,000, with over half having no programming background, and nearly 7,000 works submitted in total. XPeng has also integrated the Doubao model into its internal AI-hub and is promoting TRAE in multiple business centers. 在小鹏首届 AI 公开赛中，参赛人次超过 2.1 万，其中超过半数没有编程背景，累计提交近 7000 份作品。小鹏还将豆包模型接入内部 AI-hub，并在多个业务中心推广 TRAE。

item.title: Anthropic 建立生物实验室，拟让 Claude 指挥机器人执行实验
item.guid: Anthropic-建立生物实验室，拟让-Claude-指挥机器人执行实验
item.description:
According to Reuters, Anthropic has established a wet lab in the San Francisco Bay Area to test Claude's practical capabilities in biological experiments. Reuters observed on-site that the lab is equipped with incubators, microscopes, liquid handling equipment, and lab robots; Christina Kim, the company's head of biology research, confirmed the lab's existence. 据路透社报道，Anthropic 已在旧金山湾区建立一间湿实验室，用于测试 Claude 在生物实验中的实际能力。路透社现场看到，实验室配有培养箱、显微镜、液体处理设备和实验机器人；公司生物学研究负责人 Christina Kim 证实了实验室的存在。

Anthropic hopes to involve Claude in designing experiments and further instructing robots to perform operations such as pipetting, then adjusting the next round of experiments based on the results. Kim stated that human supervision is still required at this stage, and the lab is not specifically for drug discovery; specific research diseases and progress have not yet been disclosed. Anthropic 希望让 Claude 参与设计实验，并进一步指挥机器人完成移液等操作，再根据结果调整下一轮实验。Kim 表示，现阶段仍需要人工监督，实验室也没有专门用于药物发现，具体研究疾病和进度尚未公开。

The company stated that this work is also used to evaluate the model's capabilities and risks in the biological field. Currently, the lab will not conduct clinical trials, and Claude's ability to stably complete continuous experiments still needs to be verified. 公司称，这项工作也用于评估模型在生物领域的能力与风险。目前实验室不会开展临床试验，Claude 稳定完成连续实验的能力仍待验证。

item.title: 巴菲特卸任伯克希尔董事长，其子霍华德接任
item.guid: 巴菲特卸任伯克希尔董事长，其子霍华德接任
item.description:
Berkshire Hathaway announced on September 18 that Warren Buffett would transition to honorary chairman, effective immediately, continuing to serve as a director and provide advice to the company; his eldest son, Howard G. Buffett, was elected chairman. Susan Decker will continue to serve as lead independent director. 伯克希尔·哈撒韦 9 月 18 日宣布，沃伦·巴菲特即日起转任荣誉董事长，继续担任董事并向公司提供意见；其长子霍华德·巴菲特当选董事长。Susan Decker 继续担任首席独立董事。

In a letter to shareholders, Buffett stated that Greg Abel has fully assumed the CEO's responsibilities and is in charge of the company's important decisions. After this handover, Abel will continue to operate the company, and Howard will be responsible for safeguarding Berkshire's culture and values, with the roles of chairman and CEO being separately undertaken by the two. 巴菲特在致股东信中表示，Greg Abel 已经全面履行 CEO 职责并负责公司的重要决策。此次交接后，Abel 继续经营公司，霍华德负责守护伯克希尔的文化与价值观，董事长和 CEO 的职责由两人分别承担。

Howard has served as a Berkshire director since 1993 and is currently the Chairman and CEO of the Howard G. Buffett Foundation. Buffett stated that he will remain with the company as a shareholder. 霍华德自 1993 年起担任伯克希尔董事，现任 Howard G. Buffett Foundation 董事长兼 CEO。巴菲特称自己将继续作为股东留在公司。

item.title: 比亚迪召回 18.32 万辆唐、秦车型，涉及制动灯常亮隐患
item.guid: 比亚迪召回-18.32-万辆唐、秦车型，涉及制动灯常亮隐患
item.description:
The State Administration for Market Regulation announced on September 18 that BYD Auto Industry Co., Ltd. and BYD Automobile Co., Ltd. have filed two proactive recall plans, involving a total of 183,211 domestically produced vehicles, with the recall effective immediately. 市场监管总局 9 月 18 日公布，比亚迪汽车工业有限公司和比亚迪汽车有限公司备案两项主动召回计划，共涉及 183211 辆国产汽车，召回自即日起实施。

This includes 142,895 units of certain Tang, all-new Tang DM, and all-new Tang EV models produced between March 2015 and January 2022; and another 40,316 units of certain Qin series vehicles produced between June 2014 and June 2019. 其中包括 2015 年 3 月至 2022 年 1 月间生产的部分唐、全新一代唐 DM 和全新一代唐 EV，共 142895 辆；另有 2014 年 6 月至 2019 年 6 月间生产的部分秦系列汽车 40316 辆。

The reason for the recall is that some vehicles' brake pedal stopper pads have abnormal material batches, which may crack or fall off after long-term use. In extreme cases, this could cause the brake lights to remain on when the brake pedal is not pressed, sending incorrect signals to following vehicles. BYD authorized dealers will replace the improved stopper pads free of charge; vehicles that have already had them replaced do not need to be processed again. 召回原因是部分车辆的制动踏板限位垫存在材料批次异常，长期使用后可能开裂或脱落，极端情况下会使制动踏板未踩下时制动灯常亮，向后车传递错误信号。比亚迪授权经销商将免费更换改善后的限位垫；此前已经更换的车辆无需重复处理。

item.title: 英伟达投资的 Nscale 申请赴美上市，上半年营收同比增长 1252%
item.guid: 英伟达投资的-Nscale-申请赴美上市，上半年营收同比增长-1252%
item.description:
Nscale filed an S-1 document with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on September 18, intending to apply for listing on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol "NSCL". The London-based AI infrastructure company has not yet determined the offering size, price, or number of shares. Nscale 9 月 18 日向美国证券交易委员会提交 S-1 文件，拟申请在纽约证券交易所上市，股票代码为「NSCL」。这家总部位于伦敦的 AI 基础设施公司尚未确定发行规模、发行价和股份数量。

The document shows that Nscale's revenue in the first half of this year was $140.6 million, compared to $10.4 million in the same period last year, a year-on-year increase of 1252%; net loss during the same period expanded from $368.9 million to $1.0201 billion. The company attributed the growth to more data centers and GPU deployments coming online, while losses were impacted by data center construction, GPU depreciation, personnel costs, and financing-related expenses. 文件显示，Nscale 今年上半年营收为 1.406 亿美元，去年同期为 1040 万美元，同比增长 1252%；同期净亏损从 3.689 亿美元扩大至 10.201 亿美元。公司将增长归因于更多数据中心和 GPU 部署投入使用，亏损则受到数据中心建设、GPU 折旧、人员成本和融资相关支出影响。

As of August 31, the total value of Nscale's long-term contracts already in operation was approximately $2.6 billion, and the total value of contracts already in operation and signed combined was approximately $103.4 billion, corresponding to approximately 461,000 GPUs either in operation or under contract. The company stated that the funds raised from the listing will be used for data center projects, technology development, working capital, and daily operations. 截至 8 月 31 日，Nscale 已投入运行的长期合同总价值约为 26 亿美元，已投入运行和已签约合同总价值合计约 1034 亿美元，对应约 46.1 万块已运行或已签约 GPU。公司称，上市募集资金将用于数据中心项目、技术开发、营运资金及日常运营。

item.title: 环球音乐与索尼再诉 Suno，指控 v6 延续未授权训练成果
item.guid: 环球音乐与索尼再诉-Suno，指控-v6-延续未授权训练成果
item.description:
Universal Music Group and Sony Music again sued AI music generation platform Suno on September 18, alleging that its newly released v6 model continues to utilize unauthorized copies of sound recordings. Suno had previously stated that v6 was the company's first model trained entirely using licensed music. 环球音乐集团和索尼音乐 9 月 18 日再次起诉 AI 音乐生成平台 Suno，指控其新发布的 v6 模型继续利用未经授权复制的录音制品。Suno 此前称，v6 是该公司首个完全使用授权音乐训练的模型。

The two record companies allege in their lawsuit that Suno trained v6 using outputs generated by older models, user preference signals, and interaction data, and these older models themselves are the subject of the parties' first lawsuit in 2024. The plaintiffs also claim that Suno used model migration methods such as knowledge distillation to allow the new model to inherit the behavior of the old models, thus making it impossible to sever ties with the original training materials. 两家唱片公司在诉状中主张，Suno 用旧模型产生的输出、用户偏好信号和互动数据训练 v6，而旧模型本身正是双方 2024 年首起诉讼的对象。原告还称，Suno 通过知识蒸馏等模型迁移方法让新模型继承旧模型的行为，因此无法切断与原有训练材料的关系。

Suno has not yet responded to the new lawsuit. Warner Music has settled with Suno and established a partnership, and BMG and Believe have also provided licensed content to v6; Universal Music and Sony, however, continue to ask the court to rule that the new model still infringes their recording copyrights. Suno 尚未对新诉讼回应。华纳音乐已与 Suno 和解并建立合作，BMG、Believe 也向 v6 提供授权内容；环球音乐与索尼则继续要求法院认定新模型仍侵犯其录音版权。

item.title: 宁德时代倪军：全固态电池产业化至少还需 5 年
item.guid: 宁德时代倪军：全固态电池产业化至少还需-5-年
item.description:
CATL's Chief Manufacturing Officer Ni Jun stated in an interview that all-solid-state batteries are at least 5 years away from industrialization. Fundamental scientific problems such as the 'solid-solid interface' still exist, and technical, engineering, product, price, and supply chain issues must then be solved in sequence. 宁德时代首席制造官倪军在采访中表示，全固态电池距离产业化至少还有 5 年。当前仍存在「固固界面」等基础科学问题，之后还要依次解决技术、工程、产品、价格和供应体系问题。

Ni Jun believes that sodium-ion batteries and condensed-matter batteries are compatible with existing production lines and are closer to large-scale application. The difficulty in power battery manufacturing lies in large-scale consistency: producing a single sample in the lab does not equate to stable replication across millions of cells. 倪军认为，钠离子电池和凝聚态电池可以兼容现有生产线，更接近规模化应用。动力电池制造的难点则在于大规模一致性：实验室里做出单个样品，不等于能在数百万个电芯上稳定复制。

This statement provides CATL's judgment on the technology roadmap and timeline, and does not mean that a mass production date for all-solid-state batteries has been confirmed. 这番表态给出了宁德时代对技术路线和时间表的判断，不代表全固态电池已经确定量产节点。

item.title: 💡 Spirit AI 高阳：机器人「大脑」最快在 2027 年迎来 GPT-3 时刻
item.guid: 💡-Spirit-AI-高阳：机器人「大脑」最快在-2027-年迎来-GPT-3-时刻
item.description:
Gao Yang, founder of Spirit AI, predicted in an interview with Reuters that robot 'brains' could see a GPT-3-like leap in capability as early as 2027. She expects that by mid-2027, users might be able to use natural language to make robots perform a series of actions continuously, without needing to program them step-by-step. Spirit AI 创始人高阳在接受路透社采访时判断，机器人「大脑」最快会在 2027 年出现类似 GPT-3 的能力跃迁。她预计，到 2027 年年中，用户或许可以用自然语言让机器人连续完成一系列动作，而不必逐步编程。

Gao Yang separates the implementation times for different scenarios: industrial applications will take about 1 to 2 years, simple commercial services like hotels and restaurants about 2 years, and robots entering ordinary homes will take at least about 8 years. 高阳把不同场景的落地时间分开来看：工业应用约需 1 至 2 年，酒店、餐厅等简单商业服务约需 2 年，机器人进入普通家庭至少还要约 8 年。

She believes that training data remains the main bottleneck. Internet text can be replicated on a large scale, but robots need to accumulate action and feedback data in real environments; data between different hardware, scenarios, and tasks is also difficult to generalize directly. 她认为，训练数据仍是主要瓶颈。互联网文本可以大规模复制，机器人却需要在真实环境中积累动作和反馈数据；不同硬件、场景和任务之间的数据也难以直接通用。

item.title: 智谱推出 GLM-5.3-FlashX，最高输出速度达 200 tokens/s
item.guid: 智谱推出-GLM-5.3-FlashX，最高输出速度达-200-tokens/s
item.description:
Zhipu has launched GLM-5.3-FlashX, which officially claims a maximum output speed of 200 tokens/s. The model API is now open, with the Model Key being `GLM-5.3-FlashX`. 智谱上线 GLM-5.3-FlashX，官方称其最高输出速度达 200 tokens/s。模型 API 已开放，Model Key 为 `GLM-5.3-FlashX`。

This update primarily targets response speed in dialogue and Agent tasks. Zhipu also stated that the foundational model runs on inference computing power composed of 100,000 domestically produced chips. 这次更新主要针对对话和 Agent 任务中的响应速度。智谱还称，该基础模型运行在 10 万张国产芯片组成的推理算力上。

item.title: 阿里发布 Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash，支持 1M Token 多模态输入
item.guid: 阿里发布-Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash，支持-1M-Token-多模态输入
item.description:
Alibaba Cloud has launched Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash. The new model can simultaneously receive text, images, audio, and video, and output results as text. The official documentation lists a context length of 1M Tokens and a maximum output of 131072 Tokens. 阿里云上线 Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash，新模型可同时接收文本、图片、音频和视频，以文本输出结果。官方文档列出的上下文长度为 1M Token，最大输出为 131072 Token。

It supports Function Calling, internet search, and caching, with audio understanding covering 113 languages and dialects. Compared to models that only process a single medium, its focus is on combining graphic, text, audio, and video content in a single request, then calling tools to complete subsequent tasks. 它支持 Function Calling、联网搜索和缓存，音频理解覆盖 113 种语言及方言。与只处理单一媒介的模型相比，它的重点是在一次请求中组合图文音视频内容，再调用工具完成后续任务。

item.title: 义乌商城开卖载人飞碟，售价 80 万元、续航 15 分钟
item.guid: 义乌商城开卖载人飞碟，售价-80-万元、续航-15-分钟
item.description:
A two-seater manned flying saucer has entered the Yiwu Global Digital Trade Center for display and sale, priced at 800,000 yuan. The product can carry 1 to 2 people, has a flight height of about 30 meters, a single endurance of about 15 minutes, and is mainly used for sightseeing, exhibitions, and other scenarios. 一款双座载人飞碟进入义乌全球数贸中心展示销售，单价 80 万元。产品可载 1 至 2 人，飞行高度约 30 米，单次续航约 15 分钟，主要用于观光、展示等场景。

The 'nearly 120 million yuan order' mentioned in the report is not a new transaction, but a pre-sale agreement signed last year: it includes 68 two-seater manned versions and 86 static display versions. The new development this time is the product's entry into the Yiwu market for display and sale. 报道提到的「近 1.2 亿元订单」并非本次新成交，而是去年签下的预售协议：其中包括 68 台双座载人版和 86 台静态展示版。本次的新进展是产品进入义乌市场展示销售。

item.title: 魔搭上线开源贡献实践证明，模型、数据集和 AI 应用均可申领
item.guid: 魔搭上线开源贡献实践证明，模型、数据集和-AI-应用均可申领
item.description:
The ModelScope community announced the official launch of its 'Proof of Practice' feature. Users who participate in open-source contributions and meet the corresponding badge conditions can apply for an electronic certificate. Contribution areas include model publishing, dataset construction, AI application development in the creation space, and community co-building. 魔搭 ModelScope 社区宣布「实践证明」功能正式上线。参与开源贡献并满足对应勋章条件的用户，可申请电子证书，贡献范围包括模型发布、数据集建设、创空间 AI 应用开发和社区共建。

According to the official ModelScope community WeChat account, the contribution data in the proof comes from platform statistics. Each certificate has a unique number, and scanning the QR code allows viewing the contributor's community homepage. The application portal is on the badge management page: after meeting the application conditions, click 'Download Proof,' and the system will generate an electronic certificate. 据魔搭社区官方公众号介绍，证明中的贡献数据来自平台统计，每份证书带有唯一编号，扫码可查看贡献者的社区主页。申请入口在勋章管理页：达到申领条件后点击「下载证明」，系统会生成电子证书。

The announcement displays sample proofs for application development, model development, and technical evangelism contributors, with issuance dates including September 16th and 17th. Certificates are issued by the community and record open-source practice achievements on the platform. 公告展示了应用开发、模型开发及技术布道贡献者的证明样例，其中签发日期包括 9 月 16 日和 17 日。证书由社区签发，记录的是平台上的开源实践成果。

item.title: 达摩院开源 DAMO RADAR，腹部 CT 模型覆盖 146 种影像表现
item.guid: 达摩院开源-DAMO-RADAR，腹部-CT-模型覆盖-146-种影像表现
item.description:
Alibaba DAMO Academy announced on September 18th the open-sourcing of DAMO RADAR, a general abdominal CT model developed with institutions such as the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhejiang University School of Medicine. The related paper was published in 'Science' on September 17th; the model was trained using over 400,000 enhanced abdominal CT scans and 15 million sets of image-text data aligned by anatomical structure, learning directly from clinical reports without additional manual annotation. 阿里达摩院 9 月 18 日宣布开源与浙江大学医学院附属第一医院等机构开发的腹部 CT 通用模型 DAMO RADAR。相关论文已于 9 月 17 日登上《科学》；模型使用超过 40 万次增强腹部 CT 检查和 1500 万组按解剖结构对齐的图文数据训练，直接从临床报告中学习，无需额外人工标注。

RADAR covers 18 anatomical structures and 146 imaging manifestations. The research team conducted internal and external evaluations on multi-center data and arranged for 26 radiologists to participate in image reading studies; model assistance improved doctors' diagnostic sensitivity by an average of about 10%. RADAR 覆盖 18 个解剖结构和 146 种影像表现。研究团队在多中心数据上进行内外部评估，并安排 26 名放射科医生参与读片研究；模型辅助使医生的诊断敏感性平均提高约 10%。

The project code is open-sourced under the Apache 2.0 license, and pre-trained weights and accompanying files can be downloaded from Hugging Face. The repository also provides demo data, prediction results, and training and inference instructions. 项目代码以 Apache 2.0 许可证开源，预训练权重和配套文件可从 Hugging Face 下载。仓库同时提供演示数据、预测结果和训练、推理说明。

item.title: MiniMax 开源 Code CLI
item.guid: MiniMax-开源-Code-CLI
item.description:
MiniMax has open-sourced the MiniMax Code CLI. The current repository corresponds to the 0.4.12 source preview, and first-party code defaults to the MIT license. The project covers terminal interactive interface, headless execution mode, and Agent Client Protocol, allowing for reading and modifying code, running commands, and testing, as well as supporting search, plugins, and multimodal tools. MiniMax 已开放 MiniMax Code CLI 的源码，当前仓库对应 0.4.12 source preview，第一方代码默认采用 MIT 许可证。项目覆盖终端交互界面、无头执行模式和 Agent Client Protocol，可读取及修改代码、运行命令和测试，也支持搜索、插件及多模态工具。

Developers can log in with a MiniMax account or connect to model services compatible with OpenAI Completions, OpenAI Responses, or Anthropic Messages via BYOK. The official repository also provides source code builds, version evidence, and third-party dependency instructions. 开发者可以使用 MiniMax 账号登录，也可以通过 BYOK 接入兼容 OpenAI Completions、OpenAI Responses 或 Anthropic Messages 的模型服务。官方仓库同时提供源码构建、版本证据和第三方依赖说明。

This open-sourcing does not include the source code for MiniMax Code desktop client. The desktop application can still be downloaded separately, and the relevant repository currently only provides an entry point for issue feedback. 此次开源不包含 MiniMax Code 桌面端源码。桌面应用仍可单独下载，相关仓库目前只为其提供问题反馈入口。

item.title: 12306 回应国庆高铁票价：节假日浮动不等于票价基准上涨
item.guid: 12306-回应国庆高铁票价：节假日浮动不等于票价基准上涨
item.description:
Regarding the alleged 'price increase' for some high-speed rail tickets during the National Day holiday, 12306 customer service responded that discounts for different dates may fluctuate with passenger flow and other factors. Price changes displayed during holidays do not represent a baseline increase in ticket prices; the actual price is subject to the 12306 page. 针对国庆假期部分高铁票被质疑「涨价」，12306 客服回应称，不同日期的折扣可能随客流等因素浮动，节假日显示的价格变化并不代表票价基准上涨，实际票价以 12306 页面为准。

Customer service also stated that they cannot guarantee which ticket purchase period will offer larger discounts. Generally, prices do not change significantly after tickets are released, but special circumstances may still occur. 客服同时表示，无法保证哪一个购票时段的折扣更大。一般情况下，开票后价格不会出现很大变化，但特殊情况仍可能出现。

item.title: 水滴筹将平台服务费从 6% 提至 8%，单个项目上限 8000 元
item.guid: 水滴筹将平台服务费从-6%-提至-8%，单个项目上限-8000-元
item.description:
Shuidichou customer service confirmed that the platform has adjusted its fee standards for fundraising projects initiated from August 15th. The platform service fee has increased from 6% to 8% of the fundraising amount, with a cap of 8,000 yuan per project; an additional 0.6% third-party payment channel fee is also required upon withdrawal. 水滴筹客服确认，平台已对 8 月 15 日起发起的筹款项目调整收费标准，平台服务费从筹款金额的 6% 提高到 8%，单个项目服务费上限为 8000 元；提现时还需支付 0.6% 的第三方支付通道费。

A withdrawal page disclosed by a patient's family member showed that a 6,831 yuan fundraiser was charged 546.48 yuan in service fees and 41.04 yuan in channel fees. The platform stated that extremely impoverished individuals are exempt from service fees, and there are corresponding subsidies in special circumstances such as disasters and major accidents. 一名患者家属披露的提现页面显示，6831 元筹款被收取 546.48 元服务费和 41.04 元通道费。平台称，特困人群可免收服务费，灾害、重大事故等特殊情况下也有相应补贴。

item.title: 迪士尼任命首位 CTO，Character.AI 前 CEO Anand 加盟
item.guid: 迪士尼任命首位-CTO，Character.AI-前-CEO-Anand-加盟
item.description:
Disney announced the appointment of Karandeep Anand as the company's first CTO. He will report directly to the new CEO Josh D’Amaro and will be responsible for infrastructure, product, engineering, and data and AI platform teams. 迪士尼宣布任命 Karandeep Anand 为公司首位 CTO。他将直接向新任 CEO Josh D’Amaro 汇报，负责基础设施、产品、工程以及数据和 AI 平台团队。

Anand previously served as CEO of Character.AI for over a year, driving the AI chatbot company to expand into short-form drama content. Last year, Disney issued a cease and desist notice to Character.AI, accusing its tools of unauthorized use of copyrighted character images; now, bringing in a technology leader from that company indicates that Disney is re-integrating its AI, data, and product technology teams. Anand 此前担任 Character.AI CEO 一年多，推动这家 AI 聊天机器人公司拓展微短剧业务。迪士尼去年曾向 Character.AI 发出停止侵权通知，指控其工具未经授权使用受版权保护的角色形象；如今又从该公司引入技术负责人，显示迪士尼正在重新整合 AI、数据和产品技术团队。

item.title: One Fun Thing｜好莱坞标志变成《速度与激情》投影幕
item.guid: One-Fun-Thing｜好莱坞标志变成《速度与激情》投影幕
item.description:
Recently, images from 'Fast & Furious' lit up the white letters on the Hollywood Hills. Universal Studios collaborated with the Hollywood Chamber of Commerce, using projection mapping technology to project movie clips and new roller coaster footage onto the sign's letters, promoting the opening of Fast & Furious: Hollywood Drift. 最近，好莱坞山上的白色大字亮起了《速度与激情》的影像。环球影城与好莱坞商会合作，使用投影映射技术，把电影片段和新过山车画面投到标志的字母上，为 Fast & Furious: Hollywood Drift 开业宣传。

This sign originally read 'Hollywoodland' in 1923, used to promote a real estate project, and only later became a symbol of Los Angeles. Today, the giant letters have taken on another advertising job: serving as a projection screen for race cars and roller coasters. 这处标志 1923 年最初写的是「Hollywoodland」，用于宣传房地产项目，后来才成为洛杉矶的城市象征。如今，巨大的字母又接到一份广告工作：给赛车和过山车当投影幕。

item.title: 周末看什么｜《The History of Concrete》沿着混凝土走进纽约日常
item.guid: 周末看什么｜《The-History-of-Concrete》沿着混凝土走进纽约日常
item.description:
John Wilson's first feature-length documentary after the HBO series 'How To with John Wilson' focuses on concrete. He first attended a Hallmark screenwriting course, attempting to learn how to fund a film about concrete, then wove together observations of New York's construction, leaks, bridges, and housing into a single narrative. John Wilson 在 HBO 纪录系列《How To with John Wilson》之后拍出的首部纪录长片，把镜头对准混凝土。他先去参加 Hallmark 的编剧课程，试图学会如何为一部混凝土电影筹资，随后把纽约的施工、漏水、桥梁和住房串进同一趟观察。

The film continues his method of finding connections in everyday details. Wilson said in a 'New Yorker' interview that he would cut out his favorite ten-second clips from daily footage and then look for transitional images around the interview framework. 'The New Yorker's authoritative film review believes that through these discoveries, the film connects infrastructure with human life. 影片延续了他从日常细节里寻找联系的拍法。Wilson 在《纽约客》采访中说，他会从每天的素材中剪出自己喜欢的十秒片段，再围绕采访骨架寻找过渡影像。《纽约客》的权威影评认为，电影通过这些发现，把基础设施和人的生活联系起来。

This 101-minute documentary is distributed by Magnolia and will be screened at the IFC Center in New York starting September 18th. Some screenings on September 19th will feature a Q&A with Wilson or an extended introduction. 这部 101 分钟的纪录片由 Magnolia 发行，9 月 18 日起在纽约 IFC Center 放映。9 月 19 日的部分场次安排了 Wilson 映后问答或延长导言。

item.title: 买书不读指南｜《重新回到生活》追问技术如何改变工作与情绪
item.guid: 买书不读指南｜《重新回到生活》追问技术如何改变工作与情绪
item.description:
Wang Xiaowei, a professor at the School of Philosophy, Renmin University of China, discusses how efficiency and rationality enter work, emotions, love, and death in his book 'Returning to Life: Work, Emotions, Love, and Death in the Age of Technology,' drawing from his own technological perceptions. 中国人民大学哲学院教授王小伟在《重新回到生活：科技时代的工作、情绪、爱情和死亡》中，从自己的技术感受出发，讨论效率与理性如何进入工作、情绪、爱情和死亡。

He juxtaposes everyday experiences with the ideas of Rousseau, Nietzsche, Jaspers, and others, questioning how physical and meaningful sensations are altered in a deeply technologized life. The book's stance revolves around 'defending daily life,' while also retaining the author's specific dilemmas as a technology user. 他把日常体验与卢梭、尼采、雅思贝尔斯等人的思想放在一起，追问深度技术化的生活里，体感与意义感如何被改变。书的立场围绕「保卫日常生活」展开，同时保留了作者作为技术使用者的具体困惑。

The book will be published by CITIC Press Group in August 2026. 该书由中信出版集团于 2026 年 8 月出版。

item.title: 游戏推荐｜《林间小世界》随手画出拱门与城堡
item.guid: 游戏推荐｜《林间小世界》随手画出拱门与城堡
item.description:
'Tiny Glade' is a gridless building game. Draw a path through a wall, and an arch will automatically generate; widen a wall, and columns will appear; lower a wall, and it will turn into a fence or a regular door. Bricks and wood recombine according to the player's actions. 《林间小世界》（Tiny Glade）是一款无网格的建筑游戏。画一条穿过墙壁的小路，墙面会自动生成拱门；把墙加宽，会出现立柱；压低墙体，又会变成篱笆或普通门。砖石和木材随玩家操作重新组合。

This game, developed by Pounce Light, has no management tasks, combat, or failure conditions. Vines climb buildings, sheep roam nearby, and fireflies appear at night. The game was released in September 2024, and the Steam page currently lists support for Windows, macOS, and Linux, with simplified Chinese reviews being 'Overwhelmingly Positive'. Pounce Light 开发的这款作品没有管理任务、战斗或失败条件。藤蔓爬上建筑，绵羊在附近走动，夜间则有萤火虫。游戏于 2024 年 9 月发行，目前 Steam 页面列出 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 支持，简体中文评测为「好评如潮」。
